label: Input
summary: The signal coming into the pedal. Exactly one.

label: Output
summary: The signal leaving the pedal. Exactly one.

label: Gain
summary: Scales the signal, in decibels or by a multiplier, smoothly.

fields.name: db
fields.label: Gain
fields.summary: Gain in decibels; eased in the linear domain

fields.name: linear
fields.label: Multiplier
fields.summary: A plain multiplier instead of decibels; set one or the other

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smoothing
fields.summary: Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block

label: Filter
summary: A second-order filter: lowpass, highpass, peak, shelf or notch.

fields.name: type
fields.label: Type
fields.summary: The design: a cut, a bell, a shelf or a notch

fields.name: freq
fields.label: Frequency
fields.summary: Corner or centre frequency

fields.name: gain
fields.label: Gain
fields.summary: Boost or cut for a peak or shelf; the cuts and the notch ignore it

fields.name: q
fields.label: Q
fields.summary: Width: 0.7071 is a flat Butterworth cut

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smoothing
fields.summary: Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block

label: Waveshaper
summary: Clips or folds the signal through a curve, oversampled so the harmonics do not alias.

fields.name: curve
fields.label: Curve
fields.summary: The transfer curve; what it does past full scale is the character

fields.name: oversample
fields.label: Oversampling
fields.summary: 1, 2, 4 or 8 times the rate; anything above 1 adds 22 samples of latency, the same at every factor

label: Delay
summary: A delay line with feedback and a dry/wet mix; bind the time to an lfo for chorus and flanging.

fields.name: time
fields.label: Time
fields.summary: Delay in milliseconds; a change slides the read head, like tape

fields.name: feedback
fields.label: Feedback
fields.summary: How much of the delayed signal goes round again

fields.name: mix
fields.label: Mix
fields.summary: Dry at 0, the delayed signal alone at 1

fields.name: max
fields.label: Longest time
fields.summary: The line's length; memory is reserved for this at prepare

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smoothing
fields.summary: Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block

label: LFO
summary: A low-frequency oscillator, free or synced to the tempo. Drives other nodes' fields; it carries no audio.

fields.name: rate
fields.label: Rate
fields.summary: Cycles per second when not synced

fields.name: shape
fields.label: Shape
fields.summary: The wave

fields.name: sync
fields.label: Sync
fields.summary: Lock to the transport at the note value instead of the rate

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.summary: Cycle length when synced, in note values

fields.name: depth
fields.label: Depth
fields.summary: Scales the output; bindings see 0 at no depth

fields.name: phase
fields.label: Phase
fields.summary: Where in the cycle the wave is read, in cycles

fields.name: spread
fields.label: Stereo spread
fields.summary: How far ahead the right channel reads, in cycles

fields.name: unipolar
fields.label: Unipolar
fields.summary: Run from 0 to 1 instead of -1 to 1, so a map's ends are the wave's

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smoothing
fields.summary: Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block

label: Allpass
summary: A cascade of allpass stages with feedback: flat in level, it shifts phase, and mixed with the dry signal makes the notches of a phaser.

fields.name: stages
fields.label: Stages
fields.summary: First-order allpasses in a row; each pair makes a notch when mixed with the dry signal

fields.name: freq
fields.label: Frequency
fields.summary: Where the phase shift is centred

fields.name: feedback
fields.label: Feedback
fields.summary: The cascade's output fed back to its input, which deepens the notches

fields.name: mix
fields.label: Mix
fields.summary: Dry at 0, the shifted signal alone at 1; a phaser sits at 0.5

fields.name: smooth
fields.label: Smoothing
fields.summary: Seconds a parameter change takes to settle; 0 applies it on the next block

label: Mix
summary: Sums everything connected to it. Put gains in front to weight them.

label: Split
summary: Passes the signal through, as a junction to fan it out from.
